details.reasons: The candidate gets the order right (snooze, then dedup, then case creation). For snooze it covers the active/snooze filter selection, the skip when expiration is missing, the break on an expired filter that stops later filters, and the empty-expression case that snoozes everything. The 45-minute default comes from SIGNAL_DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MINUTES and applies only when the signal has no filters; it also notes the stale 1-hour docstring. Per-filter windows are treated as seconds, and it gives the 3600 column default and the 600 Pydantic default. The filter-dedup path is described correctly: non-canary, shares an entity, earliest match. Canary handling is right: never deduplicated, can be snoozed, and no case is created. It does not point out that the UI labels windows as minutes, a minor gap. Its extra observations (a snoozed instance being picked as a dedup target, and unordered filters) are hedged and do not contradict the reference.
